← 4S hardware

Smart Safety Watch

A connected wearable for indoor and outdoor worker location, geofence alerts and SOS on construction sites.

Discuss your project↘

How it works

Indoor and outdoor location

Use GPS/BeiDou outdoors. Indoors, battery-powered Bluetooth Location Trackers identify the zone where the wearer is located.

Worker alerts

The platform supports SOS, geofence and low-battery alerts. The Hong Kong site firmware described in the deck adds fall alerts and inactivity reminders.

Site platform and API

Review location history and alert events on the web or mobile platform. API integration with a third-party Centralised Management Platform (CMP) can be scoped for the project.

Configuration and specifications

Connectivity
4G Cat. 1 and Bluetooth Low Energy 5.0
Enclosure
48 × 52 × 15.5 mm; approximately 50 g; IPX5 water resistance
Battery
450 mAh. The deck indicates 5–7 days at the default 10-minute reporting interval; actual runtime depends on connectivity and use.

Discuss your project

Start with a CAD floor plan and the areas you want to monitor. We can plan indoor beacon locations and review worker alert escalation, charging arrangements and the handling of location data.
